author: Minoteur
body:
Hello!

On June 24, 2016 I (Minoteur) was banned for “Speed-Hacking”.

I don't exactly know how to appeal so I hope I am doing this right.


I am not a hacker and have been a loyal supporter and fan of the Avicus server for a few years now. I was waiting till the staff applications were open and I really don’t want this to get in my way of becoming staff. I also have a 6 year old little brother who is an even bigger fan of Avicus and continuously uses my account to play. This server must be his favorite server and one of mine as well and neither of us would ever do anything to help hack the server and we love doing our part in helping make the Avicus community a better place, which you must understand, is quite hard to do when you're banned.

 

Thank you in Advance,

Minoteur

 

PS: This may or may not have something to do with it, but for a few minutes prior to the ban, I was experiencing excessive lag. Could this have anything to do with it?


EDIT: if you have anything to ask me, just send me an email at rida@rida.tv

title: Ban Appeal-Minoteur

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Hello,

Seeing as the staff member that punished you is no longer staff, this appeal will be escalated to senior staff.
Good luck!

Regards,
Cammy
Avicus Moderator
